basicDetails.schemeName: Raising and Accelerating MSME Performance (RAMP) Interventions: Reimbursement of Testing and Certification Cost in Wire Cable Industry- DNH&DD

state.label: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The scheme "Raising and Accelerating MSME Performance (RAMP)" Interventions is an initiative launched by the Government of India with assistance from the World Bank to enhance the performance of Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) across the country. RAMP aims to improve the productivity, competitiveness, and resilience of MSMEs through a comprehensive set of reforms, capacity-building measures, and improved access to finance and market opportunities. The scheme RAMP with "Intervention 2: Reimbursement of Testing and Certification Cost in Wire" has been implemented by the Department of Industries, Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. Through this scheme, to boost quality standards and market access, the UT Administration will provide financial assistance to MSMEs in the Wire & Cable industry for product testing and certification. Eligible units shall be reimbursed up to ₹5,00,000/- or the actual cost incurred, whichever is lower. This intervention targets support for at least 20 MSMEs.
schemeContent.benefits_md: This intervention aims to enhance the quality standards and global competitiveness of MSMEs in the Wire & Cable industry operating within the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, thereby improving their access to domestic and international markets. Under this intervention, the UT Administration will provide financial assistance in the form of reimbursement of costs incurred by MSMEs for product testing and certification, facilitating compliance with market entry requirements and industry standards. > **Quantum of Assistance (Testing and Certification cost in wire cable industry):** 1. Eligible MSMEs shall receive reimbursement up to {5,00,000 (Rupees Five Lakhs only) or the actual cost incurred for Testing and Certification, whichever is lower. 1. A minimum of 20 MSME units in the Wire & Cable industry shall be supported under this intervention. > **Conditions for Assistance (Testing and Certification cost in wire cable industry):** 1. MSME unit must be engaged in the manufacturing of Wire and Cable products. 1. The expenditure must pertain specifically to product testing and certification carried out by accredited/recognised institutions or agencies. 1. The testing/certification agency should possess a valid national/international accreditation. 1. The MSME unit must provide valid invoices and payment proofs for the testing/certification services availed. 1. MSMEs may claim reimbursement of eligible certification and testing costs, including the cost of certification renewal, subject to the reimbursement cap specified under the intervention. 1. The following categories of product testing and certifications shall be eligible for reimbursement under this intervention. This shall include, but not be limited to, certifications accredited by government-recognised bodies or authorised agencies, subject to prior approval by the competent authority. - CE Certification - UL Certification (USA/Canada) - RoHS Compliance - REACH Compliance - ISO 9001 - ISO 14001 - ISO 45001 - CPR Certification (EU) - BASEC Certification - BIS Certification - Type Test Reports from NABL-accredited laboratories. 1. The MSME unit must have been operational for a minimum period of one year prior to the date of application.

The scheme RAMP with "Intervention 2: Reimbursement of Testing and Certification Cost in Wire" has been implemented by the Department of Industries, Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu.

Through this scheme, to boost quality standards and market access, the UT Administration will provide financial assistance to MSMEs in the Wire & Cable industry for product testing and certification. This intervention aims to enhance the quality standards and global competitiveness of MSMEs in the Wire & Cable industry operating within the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, thereby improving their access to domestic and international markets. Under this intervention, the UT Administration will provide financial assistance in the form of reimbursement of costs incurred by MSMEs for product testing and certification, facilitating compliance with market entry requirements and industry standards.
Quantum of Assistance (Testing and Certification cost in wire cable industry):
Eligible MSMEs shall receive reimbursement up to {5,00,000 (Rupees Five Lakhs only) or the actual cost incurred for Testing and Certification, whichever is lower.
A minimum of 20 MSME units in the Wire & Cable industry shall be supported under this intervention.
Conditions for Assistance (Testing and Certification cost in wire cable industry):
MSME unit must be engaged in the manufacturing of Wire and Cable products.
The expenditure must pertain specifically to product testing and certification carried out by accredited/recognised institutions or agencies.
The testing/certification agency should possess a valid national/international accreditation.
The MSME unit must provide valid invoices and payment proofs for the testing/certification services availed.
MSMEs may claim reimbursement of eligible certification and testing costs, including the cost of certification renewal, subject to the reimbursement cap specified under the intervention.

The following categories of product testing and certifications shall be eligible for reimbursement under this intervention. This shall include, but not be limited to, certifications accredited by government-recognised bodies or authorised agencies, subject to prior approval by the competent authority.
CE Certification
UL Certification (USA/Canada)
RoHS Compliance
REACH Compliance
ISO 9001
CPR Certification (EU)
BASEC Certification
BIS Certification
Type Test Reports from NABL-accredited laboratories.
The MSME unit must have been operational for a minimum period of one year prior to the date of application.
Step 1:
The applicant should visit the web portal:
http://swp.dddgov.in
Step 2:
The applicant should fill in the prescribed application form (Annexure I) for the respective component.
Step 3:
The applicant should upload all required documents as per Annexure II.
Step 4:
The application should be submitted online to the General Manager, District Industries Centre (DIC).
Step 5:
The UT RAMP Programme Committee (UTRPC) will scrutinise and verify the application.
Step 6:
Based on recommendations, the DIC will issue a sanction order.
Step 7:
The approved subsidy will be credited to the applicant’s Loan or Cash Credit account via RTGS/NEFT.
Step 8:
The application will be processed within 90 days after submission of complete documents.
Step 9:
Applications are processed on a first-come, first-served basis, subject to the availability of funds.
